title: First-principles cumulant approach to the vibronic structure of spin defects
summary: Spin defects are promising building blocks for quantum technologies, but predicting how atomic vibrations reshape their electronic spectra remains challenging. Here, the authors employ a first-principles cumulant Green’s function approach that captures repeated phonon emission and absorption. For the negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond, quantum zero-point motion produces multiphonon satellites spanning 400 meV even at zero temperature. The satellite energies and intensities depend strongly on spin and orbital character, revealing how individual defect states interact with the surrounding lattice.
